🔥🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM TO CONSERVATIVES: "THEY'RE NOT COMING BACK — NOT EVEN WITH FOREIGN HELP"</u>

Mexico's president compared today's opposition to the 19th-century conservatives who invited Maximilian to rule — "antipatriotas" who lost their privileges and now seek alliances with foreign governments to return to power.

"The people are very conscious and it won't happen," Sheinbaum said while delivering support to rural women artisans in Jocotitlán as part of the Maíz es la Raíz program.

🇲🇽⚽ "Let's keep pushing women's football forward. All women have talents and qualities — how wonderful that they can now be seen." — Yolett Cervantes Cuaquehua, Tlaquilpa, Veracruz 21 years old. From a Nahua community in the mountains of Veracruz. She walked barefoot onto the National Palace stage in traditional dress and juggled the ball. She won ticket #00001 to the World Cup inaugural match on June 11.

🇲🇽⚽ "You won't represent me or the mayor. You will represent Mexico. There is no greater pride than having you represent us." — Presidenta Sheinbaum to the four World Cup ticket winners Four young women — from Veracruz, Oaxaca, Iztapalapa, and Gustavo A. Madero — won Sheinbaum's personal World Cup tickets through a nationwide ball control contest judged by Charlyn Corral, referee Katia Itzel García, and journalist Gabriela Fernández de Lara.

🇲🇽⚽ "For centuries they told us there were jobs for men, jobs for women. Sports for men, sports for women. Today those stereotypes are being broken." — Clara Brugada, Mexico City Mayor, mañanera May 29 Brugada announced a Guinness World Record attempt on June 6: "La Gran Ola Mundialista" on Paseo de la Reforma. Mexico City will host the world's largest Fan Fest at the Zócalo for the World Cup opening.

🇲🇽⚽ 1.2 million children. 96,000 teams. 28,000 schools. The largest youth football program Mexico has ever created. — Rommel Pacheco, CONADE Director, mañanera May 29 The Social World Cup finals are at the Olympic Stadium in CU today. 24 teams qualified through municipal, state, and national rounds. 106 young talents scouted for professional clubs and the national team.

🇲🇽⚽ "Every football club in Mexico should have its own academy. The boy or girl in the most remote corner of Mexico should be able to reach the national team." — Presidenta Sheinbaum, mañanera May 29 Sheinbaum called on professional clubs to build grassroots development. The Social World Cup identified talent from 28,000+ schools. A pipeline now channels top prospects to professional teams and the national squad.

🇲🇽⚽ "We want this sport to be something social — not just the business side of football." — Presidenta Sheinbaum, mañanera May 29 Mexico is hosting the World Cup for the third time. Sheinbaum's Social World Cup reached 1.2 million children through school tournaments nationwide. 106 young talents identified for professional club pipelines.

🇲🇽⚽ "Football has no gender, no owner, no borders. It belongs to the people — and to girls and women." "El futbol no tiene sexo, no tiene dueño, no tiene fronteras; es del pueblo, y es de las niñas y de las mujeres." — Clara Brugada, Mexico City Mayor, mañanera May 29 Mexico City rehabilitated 500+ soccer fields ahead of the 2026 World Cup. 18 football festivals planned across the city. The world's largest Fan Fest opens at the Zócalo on inauguration day.
